title: KMS & RBAC rollout for Private/VPC — release notes, GTM playbook, and enablement cadence
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Coordinate the technical and go-to-market work for rolling out KMS key management, default RBAC policy presets, and configurable audit-log retention for Private/VPC/on‑prem customers. Deliverables: 1) final release notes and changelog copy tuned for admins and security teams, 2) a cross-functional playbook for Sales/CS/Support including objection handling and migration steps, 3) updated onboarding/runbook for customers to rotate keys and configure audit retention without downtime. This ticket focuses on communications, docs, training, and the release cadence — engineering tasks will be referenced as dependencies and handoffs.

rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal release notes + enablement (1 week) -> Phase 1: Canary (up to 5 enterprise customers, 2 regions) with 72h observation windows -> Phase 2: Gradual ramp (25% customers, 1 week) -> Phase 3: GA. Canary will use canary flag in control plane with automatic fallback to previous behaviour if error rate > 0.5% or latency regressions exceed 25ms p95. Key rotation demo and rollback procedures documented in runbook.
release_notes_draft: Admin-facing: Introduced customer-managed KMS support with key rotation and audit trail. See migration guide for HSM integrations.
Security: Default RBAC presets now provide Admin/Operator/ReadOnly roles; finer-grained IAM can be applied per-namespace.
Observability: Audit logs retention configurable per-tenant (30/90/365 days) with export to S3/Blob destinations.
Developer impact: New API fields for key_id and audit_retention_days; backward compatible with current endpoints. See API changelog for examples.

risks_mitigation: Risk: Customers misconfigure key rotation causing service disruption -> Mitigation: provide a one-click 'preview rotation' and require staging key before production rotation
Risk: Audit log export costs unexpectedly high for long retention -> Mitigation: add retention default to 90 days and recommended export lifecycle rules
Risk: Legal flags around cross-border key metadata -> Mitigation: include opt-out for exporting key metadata and document data flows clearly in release notes
